findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "docs_resolve_library" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: docs_get_package_info, docs_get_readme, docs_check_vulnerabilities, docs_resolve_library · Private data: docs_get_readme, docs_search_docs, docs_check_vulnerabilities · Public sink: docs_get_package_info, docs_get_readme, docs_check_vulnerabilities · Destructive: docs_check_vulnerabilities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: docs_get_package_info, docs_get_readme, docs_check_vulnerabilities, docs_resolve_library · Private data: docs_get_readme, docs_search_docs, docs_check_vulnerabilities · Public sink: docs_get_package_info, docs_get_readme, docs_check_vulnerabilities · Destructive: docs_check_vulnerabilities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
